extracted.intended_audience: researchers, clinicians, trainees, and small businesses seeking NIMH grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: A high-level gateway to NIMH funding: lists funding opportunities and announcements and directs applicants to resources on writing/submitting grants, grants management, clinical research policy, training, and small business funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities & Announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Find all NIMH and cross-NIH funding opportunities, including Program Announcements (PA), Requests for Applications (RFA), and policy announcements (NOT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this section to locate current funding solicitations and official policy notices that affect funding opportunities and application options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Writing & Approval Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore the NIMH grant application process, including how to write your grant, how to submit your grant, and how the review process works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the provided guidance to prepare application components, meet submission requirements, and understand peer review and approval steps; consult specific instructions for format, required documents, and timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about how NIMH manages research grants, including policies and reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with post-award administration policies, reporting schedules, and stewardship requirements described here to maintain funding and meet NIMH expectations during project conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Find the latest NIH and NIMH policies, guidance, and resources for clinical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to NIH/NIMH clinical research policies and use provided resources to ensure human subjects protections, trial registration, reporting, and other regulatory compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore NIMH research training and career development opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and follow program-specific eligibility and application guidance for training awards, career development (K) mechanisms, fellowships, and other professional development funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small Business Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about funding opportunities for small businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult this section for information on small-business-focused mechanisms (e.g., SBIR/STTR), eligibility, and application processes tailored to commercializing research or development activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIMH Funding Strategies and Grants Management Overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Information to learn more about NIMH funding strategies, the application process, and grants management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use overview materials to understand NIMH priorities and strategic emphases when planning proposals, and to align project aims with institute priorities and administrative expectations.
